messages:
claire (PM): Short sync  new long-term roadmap item: Policy primitives + regional isolation. Need quick feedback on scope and launch gating.

sumit (Arch): Keep primitives separate from enforcement. DSL first, bind to slices later.

diego (Eng): Two engineering tracks: routing decision engine (low latency) + slice infra (capacity tagging). Prototype single-region in ~8w if minimal.

anya (SRE): Ops wants per-route telemetry, propagation SLOs, and rollback to global default. Chaos tests mandatory.

michael (Sales): Customers requesting geo-pin + residency + protection promises. Quick win: per-tenant pinning + customer FAQ.

claire (PM): Draft gates: 1) DSL v1 + docs/UI, 2) runtime routing + fallback <10ms p95, 3) region SLA demonstrable for 2w in staging, 4) published failover runbook.

sumit (Arch): Call out risks: egress costs, cache consistency, legal edge-cases. Add dependency on billing visibility.

diego (Eng): Cache strategy: local KV cache for hot keys; cold-path to policy store will spike. Need TTL & invalidation rules. Example DSL: route { match: tenant=="T-123" && region=="eu-west-1" action: route_to(slice:europe-primary) fallback:eu-fallback propagation_ttl:30s }

anya (SRE): I'll draft runbook + chaos scenarios. Recommend propagation SLO: <60s for 95%.

michael (Sales): I'll collect top-3 customer asks and prepare FAQ language.

claire (PM): Plan: Phase 0 = docs + DSL + opt-in pinning (4w); Phase 1 = routing + metrics + fallback (12w); Phase 2 = tenant slices + reserved capacity (24-36w). Action items: Sumit DSL spec this week, Diego estimate by Fri, Anya PR runbook, Michael customer asks. I'll assemble roadmap for exec.
